const formatTime = (dateObj: any) => {
    if (!dateObj) return '--:--';
    const date = dateObj.toDate ? dateObj.toDate() : new Date(dateObj);
    return isNaN(date.getTime()) ? '--:--' : date.toLocaleTimeString('es-AR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
};

// --- COMPONENTE DE ACCIÓN RÁPIDA DE CONTACTO ---
const ContactActions = ({ phone, name }: { phone: string, name: string }) => {
    if (!phone) return <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 italic">Sin tel.</span>;
    const cleanPhone = phone.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
    return (
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <a href={`tel:${cleanPhone}`} className="p-1.5 bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-200 transition-colors" title={`Llamar a ${name}`}>
                <Phone size={12}/>
            </a>
            <button onClick={() => window.open(`https://wa.me/${cleanPhone}`, '_blank')} className="p-1.5 bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-600 rounded-lg hover:bg-emerald-200 transition-colors" title="WhatsApp">
                <MessageCircle size={12}/>
            </button>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-slate-600 ml-1 hidden sm:inline">{phone}</span>
        </div>
    );
};

const ExternalMapWindow = ({ children, onClose }: any) => {
    const [containerEl, setContainerEl] = useState<HTMLElement | null>(null);
    React.useEffect(() => {
        if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
        const windowName = `MapaOperativo_${Date.now()}`;
        const newWindow = window.open('', windowName, 'width=1200,height=800,left=200,top=200');
        if (!newWindow) { alert("⚠️ Ventana bloqueada. Habilita pop-ups."); onClose(); return; }
        newWindow.document.title = "Monitor de Operaciones - Mapa";
        const styles = document.querySelectorAll('style, link[rel="stylesheet"]');
        styles.forEach(node => newWindow.document.head.appendChild(node.cloneNode(true)));
        const popupStyle = newWindow.document.createElement('style');
        popupStyle.innerHTML = POPUP_STYLES;
        newWindow.document.head.appendChild(popupStyle);
        if (document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark')) { newWindow.document.documentElement.classList.add('dark'); }
        newWindow.document.body.className = "bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-900 m-0 p-0 overflow-hidden";
        const div = newWindow.document.createElement('div');
        div.id = 'external-root';
        div.style.height = '100%';
        div.style.width = '100%';
        newWindow.document.body.appendChild(div);
        setContainerEl(div);
        const checkClosed = setInterval(() => { if (newWindow.closed) { clearInterval(checkClosed); onClose(); } }, 500);
        return () => { clearInterval(checkClosed); if (newWindow && !newWindow.closed) { newWindow.close(); } };
    }, []);
    if (!containerEl) return null;
    return createPortal(children, containerEl);
};

const GuardCard = ({ shift, statusType, onAction, isProcessing, readOnly, isCompact, onOpenResolution }: any) => {
    const isRetention = shift.isRetention === true; 
    const isConflict = !shift.isPresent && !shift.isAbsent && !isRetention && (statusType === 'LATE' || statusType === 'IMMINENT'); 
    
    const getStatusStyles = () => {
        if (isRetention) return { border: 'border-l-orange-500', bg: 'bg-orange-50 dark:bg-orange-900/20', text: 'text-orange-800 dark:text-orange-200', badge: 'bg-orange-600 text-white animate-pulse', label: 'RETENCIÓN EN CURSO' };
        if (shift.isAbsent || shift.status === 'ABSENT') return { border: 'border-l-rose-500', bg: 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-950/40', text: 'text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300', badge: 'bg-rose-600 text-white', label: 'AUSENTE' };
        if (shift.isCompleted) return { border: 'border-l-gray-300 dark:border-l-slate-600', bg: 'bg-gray-50/50 dark:bg-slate-800/30', text: 'text-gray-400 dark:text-slate-500', badge: 'bg-gray-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-gray-400 dark:text-slate-500', label: 'FINALIZADO' };
        if (shift.isEnding && shift.isPresent) return { border: 'border-l-purple-500', bg: 'bg-purple-50/30 dark:bg-purple-900/20', text: 'text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300', badge: 'bg-purple-100 dark:bg-purple-900/40 text-purple-700 dark:text-purple-300', label: 'CIERRE PRÓXIMO' };
        if (statusType === 'LATE') return { border: 'border-l-rose-500', bg: 'bg-rose-50/40 dark:bg-rose-900/20', text: 'text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300', badge: 'bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-900/40 text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300', label: 'LLEGADA TARDE' };
        if (shift.isEarlyEntry && !shift.isPresent) return { border: 'border-l-blue-500', bg: 'bg-blue-50/30 dark:bg-blue-900/20', text: 'text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300', badge: 'bg-blue-100 dark:bg-blue-900/40 text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300', label: 'ADELANTADO' };
        if (statusType === 'IMMINENT') return { border: 'border-l-orange-500', bg: 'bg-orange-50/30 dark:bg-orange-900/20', text: 'text-orange-700 dark:text-orange-300', badge: 'bg-orange-100 dark:bg-orange-900/40 text-orange-700 dark:text-orange-300', label: 'INMINENTE' };
        if (statusType === 'ACTIVE') return { border: 'border-l-emerald-500', bg: 'bg-emerald-50/20 dark:bg-emerald-900/10', text: 'text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300', badge: 'bg-emerald-100 dark:bg-emerald-900/40 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-300', label: 'EN SERVICIO' };
        return { border: 'border-l-slate-300 dark:border-l-slate-600', bg: 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-800', text: 'text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-400', badge: 'bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-700 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400', label: 'PENDIENTE' };
    };
    const style = getStatusStyles();
    
    // --- FUNCIÓN WHATSAPP INTEGRADA ---
    const handleWhatsApp = (e: any) => { 
        e.stopPropagation(); 
        if (shift.phone) {
            window.open(`https://wa.me/${shift.phone.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '')}`, '_blank'); 
        } else {
            toast.error("No hay teléfono registrado");
        }
    };
    const handleResolution = (e:any) => { e.stopPropagation(); onOpenResolution(shift); };

    if (isCompact) {
        return (
            <div className={`pl-2 pr-3 py-2 rounded-md border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 shadow-sm transition-all relative border-l-4 ${style.border} ${style.bg} flex items-center justify-between group`}>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 overflow-hidden">
                    <div className="flex flex-col min-w-[50px]"><span className="text-[10px] font-mono font-bold text-slate-400">{formatTime(shift.shiftDateObj)}</span></div>
                    <div className="flex flex-col truncate"><span className={`text-xs font-bold truncate ${shift.isCompleted && !shift.isAbsent && !isRetention ? 'text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-600 decoration-slate-300 dark:decoration-slate-600 line-through' : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200'}`}>{shift.employeeName}</span><div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[9px] text-slate-400 truncate"><Briefcase size={9} /> {shift.clientName} <span className="text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600">|</span> {style.label}</div></div>
                </div>
                {!readOnly && !shift.isCompleted && (
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity">
                         {(isConflict || isRetention) ? (<button onClick={handleResolution} title="Resolver" className="p-1.5 bg-rose-600 text-white rounded animate-pulse"><Siren size={14}/></button>) : (<>{!shift.isPresent && !shift.isAbsent ? (<button onClick={() => onAction('CHECKIN', shift.id)} disabled={isProcessing} title="Dar Presente" className="p-1.5 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-900/30 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 rounded hover:bg-indigo-600 hover:text-white transition-colors"><CheckCircle size={14} /></button>) : (<button onClick={() => onAction('CHECKOUT', shift.id)} disabled={isProcessing} title="Finalizar" className="p-1.5 bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-900/30 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 rounded hover:bg-purple-600 hover:text-white transition-colors"><LogOut size={14} /></button>)}<button onClick={() => onAction('NOVEDAD', shift.id)} title="Novedad" className="p-1.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-700 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 rounded hover:bg-rose-50 hover:text-rose-600 transition-colors"><AlertTriangle size={14} /></button></>)}
                    </div>
                )}
                {shift.isAbsent && <UserX size={16} className="text-rose-500 mr-2"/>}{isRetention && <Clock size={16} className="text-orange-500 mr-2 animate-pulse"/>}
            </div>
        );
    }
    return (
        <div className={`p-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-700 shadow-sm transition-all relative overflow-hidden group hover:shadow-md hover:border-indigo-100 dark:hover:border-slate-600 ${style.bg}`}>
            <div className={`absolute left-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-1 ${style.border}`}></div>
            {isRetention && (<div className="absolute top-2 right-2 flex items-center gap-1 text-orange-600 font-mono text-xs font-black bg-white/80 px-2 py-1 rounded shadow-sm animate-pulse"><Clock size={12}/> EN PROCESO</div>)}
            <div className="pl-2 flex justify-between items-start mb-1">
                 <div className="flex flex-col"><span className={`text-[9px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider w-fit px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded mb-1 ${style.badge}`}>{style.label}</span><h4 className={`font-bold text-sm leading-tight truncate flex items-center gap-1 ${shift.isCompleted && !shift.isAbsent && !isRetention ? 'text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-600' : 'text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100'}`}>{shift.employeeName}</h4></div>
                 <div className="text-right"><div className="text-[11px] font-black font-mono text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 bg-white/50 dark:bg-black/20 px-1 rounded">{formatTime(shift.shiftDateObj)}</div><div className="text-[9px] text-slate-400">a {formatTime(shift.endDateObj)}</div></div>
            </div>
            <div className="pl-2 mb-2">
                <div className="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 font-medium truncate flex items-center gap-1"><Building2 size={10} className="text-slate-400"/> {shift.clientName}<span className="text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600 mx-1">•</span><span className="text-slate-400">{shift.objectiveName}</span></div>
                {isRetention && <div className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-orange-700 font-bold">⚠️ Guardia retenido en puesto.</div>}
                {isConflict && <div className="mt-1 text-[10px] text-rose-600 font-bold">🔴 Requiere atención inmediata.</div>}
                {shift.isAbsent && (<div className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 bg-white/60 dark:bg-black/20 p-2 rounded border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900 italic flex items-start gap-2"><UserX size={12} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0"/>{shift.comments || "Ausencia sin aviso registrado."}</div>)}
                {(shift.isEarlyEntry || shift.isCoverage) && (<div className="mt-1.5 text-[10px] text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 bg-blue-100/50 dark:bg-blue-900/30 border border-blue-100 dark:border-blue-900/50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md inline-block font-medium">Info: {shift.coverageNote || shift.entryNote || "Cobertura operativa"}</div>)}
                {isRetention && (<div className="mt-1.5 text-[10px] text-orange-700 dark:text-orange-200 bg-orange-100/50 dark:bg-orange-900/30 border border-orange-200 dark:border-orange-800 px-2 py-1 rounded-md font-bold flex items-center gap-1"><Siren size={10} className="animate-bounce"/> Relevo pendiente. No abandonar puesto.</div>)}
            </div>
            {(!readOnly || isRetention || isConflict || shift.isAbsent) && !shift.isCompleted && (
                <div className="pl-2 mt-3 pt-2 border-t border-slate-200/50 dark:border-slate-700/50 flex gap-2">
                    {(isConflict || isRetention) ? (<button onClick={handleResolution} className="flex-1 py-1.5 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold uppercase shadow-md flex items-center justify-center gap-2 animate-pulse"><Siren size={14}/> {isRetention ? 'GESTIONAR RETENCIÓN' : 'RESOLVER INCIDENCIA'}</button>) : (<>{!shift.isPresent && !shift.isAbsent ? (<button onClick={() => onAction('CHECKIN', shift.id)} disabled={isProcessing} className="flex-1 py-1.5 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold uppercase flex items-center justify-center gap-2 hover:bg-indigo-700 transition-colors"><CheckCircle size={12}/> LLEGADA</button>) : (<button onClick={() => onAction('CHECKOUT', shift.id)} disabled={isProcessing} className="flex-1 py-1.5 bg-purple-600 text-white rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold uppercase flex items-center justify-center gap-2 hover:bg-purple-700 transition-colors"><LogOut size={12}/> SALIDA</button>)}<button onClick={() => onAction('NOVEDAD', shift.id)} className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-500 rounded-lg hover:bg-rose-50 hover:text-rose-600 transition-colors"><AlertTriangle size={14}/></button></>)}
                    
                    {/* BOTONES DE CONTACTO EN LA TARJETA */}
                    <div className="flex gap-1">
                        <button onClick={() => window.open(`tel:${shift.phone?.replace(/[^0-9]/g,'') || ''}`)} className="p-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 rounded-lg text-slate-500 transition-colors" title="Llamar"><Phone size={14}/></button>
                        <button onClick={handleWhatsApp} className="p-2 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-100 text-emerald-600 rounded-lg hover:bg-emerald-600 hover:text-white transition-colors" title="WhatsApp"><MessageCircle size={14}/></button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
};

export default function OperacionesPage() {
    const logic = useOperacionesMonitor();
    const [isExternalMap, setIsExternalMap] = useState(false);
    const [mapInstance, setMapInstance] = useState<any>(null);
    const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false); 
    
    // ESTADOS PARA MODAL Y MINIMIZADOS
    const [resolutionModal, setResolutionModal] = useState<{isOpen: boolean, shift: any | null, prevShift: any | null, step: number}>({isOpen: false, shift: null, prevShift: null, step: 1});
    const [minimizedResolutions, setMinimizedResolutions] = useState<any[]>([]);

    const handleLlegoAhora = async () => {
        if (!resolutionModal.shift) return;
        setIsProcessing(true);
        try {
            await logic.handleAction('CHECKIN', resolutionModal.shift.id);
            toast.success("Ingreso registrado");
            setResolutionModal(prev => ({ ...prev, isOpen: false })); // CERRAR MODAL
        } catch(e) { toast.error("Error al registrar ingreso"); } finally { setIsProcessing(false); }
    };

    const openResolution = async (shift: any) => {
        // Verificar si ya está minimizado
        const isMinimized = minimizedResolutions.find(m => m.shift.id === shift.id);
        if (isMinimized) {
            setResolutionModal({ isOpen: true, shift: isMinimized.shift, prevShift: isMinimized.prevShift, step: isMinimized.step });
            setMinimizedResolutions(prev => prev.filter(m => m.shift.id !== shift.id)); // Sacar de minimizados
            return;
        }

        const candidates = logic.processedData.filter((s:any) => s.objectiveId === shift.objectiveId && s.id !== shift.id && s.status !== 'ABSENT');
        
        // --- FIX: ORDENAMIENTO SEGURO ---
        candidates.sort((a:any, b:any) => {
             const endA = a.endDateObj || a.visualEndDateObj || new Date();
             const endB = b.endDateObj || b.visualEndDateObj || new Date();
             return endB.getTime() - endA.getTime();
        });

        const prevShift = candidates.find((s:any) => {
             // --- FIX: COMPARACIÓN SEGURA ---
             const endS = s.endDateObj || s.visualEndDateObj || new Date();
             const timeDiff = shift.shiftDateObj.getTime() - endS.getTime();
             return timeDiff >= -900000 && timeDiff < 14400000; 
        });
        
        // Si el turno ya está ausente o retenido, abrimos en el paso correspondiente
        let initialStep = 1;
        if (shift.status === 'ABSENT' || shift.isAbsent) initialStep = 3; // Ya confirmado, buscar reemplazo

        setResolutionModal({ isOpen: true, shift, prevShift, step: initialStep });
    };

    const minimizeModal = () => {
        if (resolutionModal.shift) {
            setMinimizedResolutions(prev => [...prev, { ...resolutionModal }]);
            setResolutionModal(prev => ({ ...prev, isOpen: false }));
        }
    };

    // PASO 2: Confirmar Ausencia y Retener Automáticamente
    const confirmAbsenceAndRetain = async (reason: string) => {
        if (!resolutionModal.shift) return;
        setIsProcessing(true);
        try {
            const batch = []; // Aquí usaríamos writeBatch si tuviéramos acceso a firebase/firestore directo
            
            // 1. Marcar Ausente
            await updateDoc(doc(db, 'turnos', resolutionModal.shift.id), { status: 'ABSENT', isAbsent: true, comments: reason });
            await addDoc(collection(db, 'novedades'), { type: 'AUSENCIA', employeeId: resolutionModal.shift.employeeId, details: reason, createdAt: serverTimestamp() });
            
            // 2. Retener al anterior (si existe)
            if (resolutionModal.prevShift) {
                await updateDoc(doc(db, 'turnos', resolutionModal.prevShift.id), { 
                    isRetention: true, 
                    status: 'PRESENT', 
                    endTime: null, 
                    retentionStartTime: serverTimestamp(), 
                    comments: 'RETENCIÓN ACTIVA: Esperando relevo.' 
                });
                toast.success("Ausencia Confirmada. PROTOCOLO DE RETENCIÓN ACTIVADO.");
            } else {
                toast.warning("Ausencia Confirmada. No se encontró guardia previo para retener.");
            }

            // 3. Avanzar al paso de cobertura
            setResolutionModal(prev => ({ ...prev, step: 3 }));

        } catch (e) { toast.error("Error al procesar"); } finally { setIsProcessing(false); }
    };

    // Liberar retenido manualmente (si hace falta)
    const stopRetention = async () => {
        if (!resolutionModal.prevShift) return;
        try { await updateDoc(doc(db, 'turnos', resolutionModal.prevShift.id), { isRetention: false, isExtended: true, endTime: serverTimestamp(), status: 'COMPLETED', comments: 'Retención finalizada.' }); toast.success("⏹️ Retención Finalizada."); setResolutionModal({ ...resolutionModal, isOpen: false }); } catch (e) { toast.error("Error"); }
    };
    
    const handleAdelantarSiguiente = async () => { toast.info("Funcionalidad: Adelantar turno siguiente"); };

    const countRetencion = logic.processedData.filter((s:any) => s.isRetention).length;
    const countPrioridad = logic.listData.length; 
    const countActivos = logic.processedData.filter((s:any) => s.isPresent).length; 
    const countHoy = logic.processedData.length;

    return (
        <DashboardLayout>
            <Toaster position="top-right" />
            <Head><title>Operaciones | Monitor</title></Head>
            <style>{POPUP_STYLES}</style>

            <div className="h-[calc(100vh-100px)] flex flex-col lg:flex-row gap-4 p-2 animate-in fade-in relative">
                {!isExternalMap && (
                    <div className="flex-1 lg:flex-[3] bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 overflow-hidden relative shadow-inner z-10">
                        <OperacionesMap 
                            center={[-31.4201, -64.1888]} 
                            objectives={logic.objectives} 
                            processedData={logic.processedData} 
                            onAction={logic.handleAction} 
                            setMapInstance={setMapInstance} 
                            onOpenResolution={openResolution} 
                        />
                        <button onClick={() => setIsExternalMap(true)} className="absolute top-4 right-4 z-[1000] bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-2 rounded-lg shadow-lg hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700" title="Ventana Flotante"><ExternalLink size={20}/></button>
                        <div className="absolute bottom-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-[1000] pointer-events-none">
                            <div className="bg-white/95 dark:bg-slate-900/95 backdrop-blur shadow-2xl rounded-full px-6 py-2 flex gap-8 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pointer-events-auto items-center">
                                {countRetencion > 0 && (<><div className="text-center animate-pulse"><div className="text-xl font-black text-orange-600 leading-none">{countRetencion}</div><div className="text-[8px] font-bold text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">RETENIDOS</div></div><div className="h-6 w-px bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700"></div></>)}
                                <div className="text-center"><div className="text-xl font-black text-rose-500 leading-none">{countPrioridad}</div><div className="text-[8px] font-bold text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Alertas</div></div>
                                <div className="h-6 w-px bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700"></div>
                                <div className="text-center"><div className="text-xl font-black text-emerald-600 leading-none">{countActivos}</div><div className="text-[8px] font-bold text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Activos</div></div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                )}
                {isExternalMap && (<ExternalMapWindow onClose={() => setIsExternalMap(false)}><div className="h-full w-full relative"><OperacionesMap center={[-31.4201, -64.1888]} objectives={logic.objectives} processedData={logic.processedData} onAction={logic.handleAction} setMapInstance={setMapInstance} isExternal={true} onOpenResolution={openResolution} /></div></ExternalMapWindow>)}
                
                <div className={`bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex flex-col overflow-hidden shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 ${isExternalMap ? 'flex-1 w-full' : 'flex-1 lg:flex-[2]'}`}>
                    <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/50 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4"><h2 className="text-lg font-black text-slate-800 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2"><Radio className="text-rose-600 animate-pulse" /> RADIO</h2><div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-xs font-mono text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 shadow-sm">{logic.now.toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'})}</div></div>
                        <div className="flex p-1 bg-slate-200/50 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-xl mb-3 gap-1">
                            <button onClick={() => logic.setViewTab('PRIORIDAD')} className={`flex-1 py-2 text-[10px] font-black uppercase rounded-lg transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1 ${logic.viewTab === 'PRIORIDAD' ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-700 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 shadow-md ring-1 ring-black/5 dark:ring-white/10' : 'text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-300'}`}><Siren size={14}/> Prioridad ({countPrioridad})</button>
                            <button onClick={() => logic.setViewTab('ACTIVOS')} className={`flex-1 py-2 text-[10px] font-black uppercase rounded-lg transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1 ${logic.viewTab === 'ACTIVOS' ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-700 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shadow-md ring-1 ring-black/5 dark:ring-white/10' : 'text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-300'}`}><CheckCircle size={14}/> Activos ({countActivos})</button>
                            <button onClick={() => logic.setViewTab('HOY')} className={`flex-1 py-2 text-[10px] font-black uppercase rounded-lg transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1 ${logic.viewTab === 'HOY' ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-700 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 shadow-md ring-1 ring-black/5 dark:ring-white/10' : 'text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-300'}`}><Calendar size={14}/> Hoy ({countHoy})</button>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex gap-2 items-center mt-3">
                             <div className="relative flex-1"><Search className="absolute left-3 top-2.5 text-slate-400" size={16}/><input className="w-full bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 pl-9 pr-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold uppercase focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 outline-none transition-all dark:text-white" placeholder="BUSCAR..." value={logic.filterText} onChange={(e) => logic.setFilterText(e.target.value)} /></div>
                             <button onClick={() => logic.setIsCompact(!logic.isCompact)} className={`p-2 rounded-xl border transition-all ${logic.isCompact ? 'bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-900/40 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800' : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-300'}`} title={logic.isCompact ? "Vista Expandida" : "Vista Compacta"}>{logic.isCompact ? <Maximize2 size={18} /> : <Minimize2 size={18} />}</button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-3 space-y-2 bg-slate-50/30 dark:bg-slate-950/30 custom-scrollbar relative">
                        {logic.listData.length === 0 ? <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full w-full col-span-full text-slate-400 opacity-60"><ListFilter size={48} className="mb-2"/><p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase">Sin datos en esta vista</p></div> : logic.listData.map((s:any) => {
                            let type = 'PENDING';
                            if (s.isLate) type = 'LATE'; else if (s.isImminent) type = 'IMMINENT'; else if (s.isPresent) type = 'ACTIVE';
                            return <GuardCard key={s.id} shift={s} statusType={type} onAction={logic.handleAction} isProcessing={logic.processingId === s.id} readOnly={logic.viewTab === 'HOY' && s.isCompleted} isCompact={logic.isCompact} onOpenResolution={openResolution} />;
                        })}
                    </div>
                    <div className="h-40 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 flex flex-col">
                        <div className="px-4 py-2 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2"><ClipboardList size={14} className="text-slate-400"/><h3 className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Bitácora del Día</h3></div>
                        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar p-0">
                            {logic.recentLogs.length === 0 ? <p className="text-center text-[10px] text-slate-300 italic py-4">Sin actividad reciente</p> : (
                                <table className="w-full text-[10px] text-left"><tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-50 dark:divide-slate-800">{logic.recentLogs.map((log:any) => (<tr key={log.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/50"><td className="px-4 py-2 font-mono text-slate-400 w-16">{log.time ? formatTime(log.time) : '--:--'}</td><td className="px-2 py-2 w-24"><span className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-bold uppercase text-[8px] border ${log.type === 'NOVEDAD' ? const getDateKey = (dateInput: any) => {
    const d = dateInput.toDate ? dateInput.toDate() : new Date(dateInput);
    const options: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions = { timeZone: 'America/Argentina/Cordoba', year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit' };
    const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('es-AR', options).formatToParts(d);
    const day = parts.find(p => p.type === 'day')?.value;
    const month = parts.find(p => p.type === 'month')?.value;
    const year = parts.find(p => p.type === 'year')?.value;
    return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
};

const isDateLocked = (dateStr: string) => {
    const [y, m, d] = dateStr.split('-').map(Number);
    const cellDate = new Date(y, m - 1, d);
    cellDate.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999); 
    const startOfToday = new Date();
    startOfToday.setHours(0,0,0,0);
    return cellDate < startOfToday; 
};

const getDefaultStyle = (code: string) => SHIFT_STYLES[code] || 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-300';

const formatTime = (dateInput: any) => {
    if (!dateInput) return '--:--';
    const d = dateInput.toDate ? dateInput.toDate() : new Date(dateInput);
    return d.toLocaleTimeString('es-AR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
};

            const existingShift = shiftsMap[titularKey]; // El turno original del titular

            // 1. Al Titular le ponemos 'V' (Vacaciones)
            // No borramos su registro, lo marcamos como Licencia para que RRHH sepa
            newChanges[titularKey] = { 
                code: 'V', // V de Vacaciones
                name: 'Vacaciones',
                isTemp: true,
                hours: 0,
                startTime: '00:00',
                comments: `Licencia: ${vacancyData.type}`
            };

            // 2. Al Suplente le asignamos el turno que tenía el titular
            if (existingShift && existingShift.code !== 'F') {
                const suplenteKey = `${replacementEmp.id}_${dateStr}`;
                newChanges[suplenteKey] = {
                    code: existingShift.code, // Mismo turno (ej: M, T, N)
                    name: existingShift.code,
                    isTemp: true,
                    objectiveId: existingShift.objectiveId, // Importante: Asignar al mismo objetivo
                    hours: existingShift.hours || 8,
                    startTime: existingShift.startTime,
                    comments: `Cubriendo a ${vacancyData.employeeName} (${vacancyData.type})`
                };
            }

            count++;
            current.setDate(current.getDate() + 1);
        }

        setPendingChanges(newChanges);
        setShowVacancyModal(false);
        setVacancyData(null);
        toast.success(`Cobertura planificada para ${count} días. Revise y guarde los cambios.`);
    };

        return () => { unsubNotif(); unsubNov(); };

    useEffect(() => { if (!selectedClient || !selectedObjective) { setPositionStructure([]); return; } const fetchSLA = async () => { try { const q = query(collection(db, 'servicios_sla'), where('clientId', '==', selectedClient)); const snap = await getDocs(q); const srv = snap.docs.map(d => d.data()).find(d => d.objectiveId === selectedObjective); const structure: any[] = []; if (srv?.positions) { srv.positions.forEach((pos: any) => { if (pos.allowedShiftTypes?.length > 0) structure.push({ positionName: pos.name || 'General', shifts: pos.allowedShiftTypes }); }); } if (structure.length === 0) structure.push({ positionName: 'General', shifts: [{code:'M',hours:8},{code:'T',hours:8},{code:'N',hours:8}] }); setPositionStructure(structure); } catch (e) { setPositionStructure([]); } }; fetchSLA(); }, [selectedClient, selectedObjective]);

    const getEmployeeShiftCount = (empId: string) => { let count = 0; daysInMonth.forEach(day => { const key = `${empId}_${getDateKey(day)}`; const pending = pendingChanges[key]; const existing = shiftsMap[key]; if (pending) { if (!pending.isDeleted) count++; } else if (existing) { if (existing.objectiveId === selectedObjective) count++; } }); return count; };

    const checkLaborRules = (empId: string, targetDate: Date, newHours: number) => { const emp = employees.find(e => e.id === empId); if (!emp) return null; const dateKey = getDateKey(targetDate); const key = `${empId}_${dateKey}`; if (absencesMap[key]) { return `ALERTA CRÍTICA: El empleado tiene una Ausencia Registrada (${absencesMap[key].type}) para esta fecha.`; } const rule = agreements.find(a => a.name === emp.laborAgreement) || agreements.find(a => a.name === 'General') || { maxHoursWeekly: DEFAULT_LIMITS.weekly, maxHoursMonthly: DEFAULT_LIMITS.monthly }; const limitMonthly = parseInt(rule.maxHoursMonthly) || DEFAULT_LIMITS.monthly; const pendingShift = pendingChanges[key]; const existingShift = shiftsMap[key]; let finalShift = pendingShift ? (pendingShift.isDeleted ? null : pendingShift) : existingShift; if (finalShift && (finalShift.code === 'F' || finalShift.isFranco)) return `ALERTA CRÍTICA: El empleado ya tiene un FRANCO asignado este día.`; const targetMonthStr = getDateKey(targetDate).substring(0,7); let monthlyTotal = 0; const daysInCurrentMonth = new Date(targetDate.getFullYear(), targetDate.getMonth() + 1, 0).getDate(); for(let d=1; d<=daysInCurrentMonth; d++) { const checkDate = new Date(targetDate.getFullYear(), targetDate.getMonth(), d); const k = `${empId}_${getDateKey(checkDate)}`; const p = pendingChanges[k]; const s = shiftsMap[k]; let active = p ? (p.isDeleted ? null : p) : s; if (active && active.code !== 'F') monthlyTotal += (SHIFT_HOURS_LOOKUP[active.code] || active.hours || 8); } if ((monthlyTotal + newHours) > limitMonthly) return `ALERTA MENSUAL: Límite de ${limitMonthly}hs superado.`; return null; };
    const handleContextChange = (newClient: string, newObjective: string) => { if (Object.keys(pendingChanges).length > 0) { if (!confirm(`⚠️ TIENES CAMBIOS SIN GUARDAR.\n¿Descartar y cambiar de objetivo?`)) return; setPendingChanges({}); } setSelectedClient(newClient); setSelectedObjective(newObjective); setSearchTerm(''); setSelection({start: null, end: null}); setComparingSnapshot(null); };
    
    // --- BUSCADOR INTELIGENTE DE VECINOS PARA CONFLICTOS ---
    const findNeighbors = (problemShift: any, dateStr: string) => {
        const candidates: any[] = [];
        Object.values(shiftsMap).forEach((s: any) => {
            if (s.objectiveId === problemShift.objectiveId && getDateKey(s.startTime) === dateStr && s.id !== problemShift.id) {
                const key = `${s.employeeId}_${dateStr}`;
                if (!absencesMap[key]) {
                    candidates.push({ ...s, employeeName: employees.find(e => e.id === s.employeeId)?.name || 'Desconocido' });
                }
            }
        });
        candidates.sort((a,b) => a.startTime.seconds - b.startTime.seconds);
        const myStart = problemShift.startTime.seconds;
        let prev = null; let next = null;
        for (const cand of candidates) {
            if (cand.startTime.seconds < myStart) prev = cand;
            if (cand.startTime.seconds > myStart && !next) next = cand;
        }
        setConflictNeighbors({ prev, next });
    };

    // ✅ MANEJO DE CLIC EN CELDA (CORREGIDO: ERROR 1 ARGUMENTO)
    const handleMouseUp = () => { 
        setIsDragging(false); 
        if (selection.start && selection.end && selection.start.r === selection.end.r && selection.start.c === selection.end.c) { 
            const emp = displayedEmployees[selection.start.r]; 
            const day = daysInMonth[selection.start.c]; 
            const dateStr = getDateKey(day);
            const key = `${emp.id}_${dateStr}`; 
            const shift = pendingChanges[key] || shiftsMap[key]; 
            const absence = absencesMap[key];

            if (selection.start.r === selection.end.r && selection.start.c === selection.end.c) { setSelection({ start: null, end: null }); }
            
            if (!pendingChanges[key]?.isDeleted) {
                if (isShiftConsolidated(shift)) {
                    setSelectedCell({ empId: emp.id, dateStr: dateStr, currentShift: shift, absence: absence });
                    return; 
                }

                // SI HAY TURNO Y AUSENCIA -> MODO CONFLICTO
                const isLocked = isDateLocked(dateStr); 
                if (!isLocked && ((shift && absence) || (shift && shift.hasNovedad))) {
                    findNeighbors(shift, dateStr);
                    setSelectedCell({ empId: emp.id, dateStr: dateStr, currentShift: shift, absence: absence });
                    setShowConflictModal(true);
                } else {
                    if (!isLocked) {
                        let initialModifiers = { extend: false, early: false, plannedNovedad: '' };
                        if (shift) {
                            initialModifiers = { extend: shift.isExtended || false, early: shift.isEarlyStart || false, plannedNovedad: shift.plannedNovedad || '' };
                        }
                        setModifiers(initialModifiers);
                        setFrancoMode('NONE');
                    }
                    setSelectedCell({ empId: emp.id, dateStr: dateStr, currentShift: shift, absence: absence });
                }
            } 
        } 
    };

    const resolveConflict = async (type: 'SPLIT' | 'FULL_COVERAGE') => { if (!selectedCell?.currentShift) return; const batch = writeBatch(db); const shiftId = selectedCell.currentShift.id; if (selectedCell.absence) { batch.update(doc(db, 'turnos', shiftId), { status: 'ABSENT', comments: 'Cubierto por ausencia' }); } else { batch.update(doc(db, 'turnos', shiftId), { hasNovedad: false, comments: 'Novedad resuelta' }); } if (type === 'SPLIT') { if (conflictNeighbors?.prev) { batch.update(doc(db, 'turnos', conflictNeighbors.prev.id), { isExtended: true, comments: 'Extensión por cobertura' }); } if (conflictNeighbors?.next) { batch.update(doc(db, 'turnos', conflictNeighbors.next.id), { isEarlyStart: true, comments: 'Adelanto por cobertura' }); } toast.success("Cobertura aplicada: Extensión + Adelanto"); } else { setShowConflictModal(false); setFrancoMode('FT_SELECTION'); return; } await batch.commit(); setShowConflictModal(false); setSelectedCell(null); };
