import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import DashboardLayout from '@/components/layout/DashboardLayout';
import { employeeService, Employee } from '@/services/employeeService';
import { auditService } from '@/services/auditService'; // <--- IMPORTANTE
import { db } from '@/lib/firebase';
import { collection, getDocs, query, where } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { useToast } from '@/context/ToastContext';
import { 
  Users, Search, Plus, Edit2, Trash2, Phone, Mail, 
  FileBadge, UserCheck, UserX, AlertCircle, MapPin, Building2
} from 'lucide-react';

export default function EmployeesPage() {
  const { addToast } = useToast();
  const [view, setView] = useState<'list' | 'form'>('list');
  const [employees, setEmployees] = useState<Employee[]>([]);
  const [filteredEmployees, setFilteredEmployees] = useState<Employee[]>([]);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);
  const [clients, setClients] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [allObjectives, setAllObjectives] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [filteredObjectives, setFilteredObjectives] = useState<any[]>([]);

  const initialForm: any = {
    firstName: '', lastName: '', dni: '', fileNumber: '', 
    phone: '', email: '', category: 'Vigilador', status: 'active',
    laborAgreement: 'SUVICO',
    preferredClientId: '', preferredObjectiveId: ''
  };

  const [form, setForm] = useState<any>(initialForm);

  useEffect(() => { loadData(); loadClientsAndObjectives(); }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    const term = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
    setFilteredEmployees(employees.filter(e => 
      e.lastName.toLowerCase().includes(term) || 
      e.firstName.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
      e.fileNumber.includes(term)
    ));
  }, [searchTerm, employees]);

  useEffect(() => {
      if (form.preferredClientId) {
          const objs = allObjectives.filter(o => o.clientId === form.preferredClientId);
          setFilteredObjectives(objs);
      } else {
          setFilteredObjectives([]);
      }
  }, [form.preferredClientId, allObjectives]);

  const loadData = async () => {
    const data = await employeeService.getAll();
    setEmployees(data);
  };

  const loadClientsAndObjectives = async () => {
      try {
        const cSnap = await getDocs(collection(db, 'clients'));
        const cList = cSnap.docs.map(d => ({ id: d.id, ...d.data() }));
        setClients(cList);

        const sSnap = await getDocs(query(collection(db, 'servicios_sla'), where('status', '==', 'active')));
        const oList = sSnap.docs.map(d => {
            const data = d.data();
            return { id: data.objectiveId, name: data.objectiveName, clientId: data.clientId };
        });
        const uniqueObjectives = Array.from(new Map(oList.map(item => [item.id, item])).values());
        setAllObjectives(uniqueObjectives);
      } catch (e) { console.error("Error cargando clientes/objetivos", e); }
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!form.lastName || !form.firstName || !form.dni) return addToast('Datos incompletos', 'error');
    try {
      if (isEditing && form.id) {
        await employeeService.update(form.id, form);
        await auditService.log('EDICION_EMPLEADO', 'RRHH', { id: form.id, ...form }); // <--- AUDITORÍA
        addToast('Legajo actualizado', 'success');
      } else {
        const id = await employeeService.add({ ...form, createdAt: new Date().toISOString() });
        await auditService.log('ALTA_EMPLEADO', 'RRHH', { ...form, id }); // <--- AUDITORÍA
        addToast('Legajo creado', 'success');
      }
      loadData();
      setView('list');
    } catch (e) { addToast('Error al guardar', 'error'); }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id: string) => {
    if(confirm('¿Eliminar legajo?')) {
      const empToDelete = employees.find(e => e.id === id); // Capturar datos antes de borrar
      await auditService.log('BAJA_EMPLEADO', 'RRHH', { ...empToDelete }); // <--- AUDITORÍA
      
      await employeeService.delete(id);
      loadData();
      addToast('Legajo eliminado', 'info');
    }
  };

  const openNew = () => { setForm(initialForm); setIsEditing(false); setView('form'); };
  const openEdit = (emp: any) => { setForm(emp); setIsEditing(true); setView('form'); };

  return (
    <DashboardLayout>
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto space-y-6 animate-in fade-in">
        <header className="flex justify-between items-end">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-4xl font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white uppercase tracking-tighter">Personal</h1>
            <p className="text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 mt-1 font-medium">Gestión de Legajos y Dotación.</p>
          </div>
          {view === 'list' && (
            <button onClick={openNew} className="bg-indigo-600 text-white px-6 py-3 rounded-xl font-black text-xs uppercase shadow-xl hover:scale-105 transition-all flex gap-2"><Plus size={16}/> Nuevo Legajo</button>
          )}
        </header>

        {view === 'list' && (
          <>
            <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 p-4 rounded-2xl border dark:border-slate-700 flex items-center gap-4 shadow-sm">
              <Search className="text-slate-400"/>
              <input placeholder="Buscar por Nombre, Apellido o Legajo..." className="w-full bg-transparent outline-none font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-white uppercase" value={searchTerm} onChange={e => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}/>
              <div className="text-xs font-black text-slate-300 uppercase px-4 border-l dark:border-slate-700">{filteredEmployees.length} Pax</div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              {filteredEmployees.map(emp => (
                <div key={emp.id} className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 p-6 rounded-[2rem] border dark:border-slate-700 shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg transition-all group relative overflow-hidden">
                   <div className={`absolute top-0 right-0 p-4 ${emp.status === 'active' ? 'text-emerald-500' : 'text-rose-500'}`}>
                      {emp.status === 'active' ? <UserCheck size={18}/> : <UserX size={18}/>}
                   </div>
                   <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mb-4">
                      <div className="w-12 h-12 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-700 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-black text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-300 text-xl">
                        {emp.firstName.charAt(0)}{emp.lastName.charAt(0)}
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <h3 className="font-black text-slate-800 dark:text-white uppercase leading-tight">{emp.lastName}</h3>
                        <p className="font-bold text-slate-500 text-sm uppercase">{emp.firstName}</p>
                        <span className="text-[10px] bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-900/30 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-black uppercase mt-1 inline-block">{emp.category}</span>
                      </div>
                   </div>
                   <div className="space-y-2 border-t dark:border-slate-700 pt-4">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400"><FileBadge size={14}/> Legajo: {emp.fileNumber || 'S/N'}</div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400"><MapPin size={14}/> Objetivo: {(allObjectives.find(o => o.id === emp.preferredObjectiveId)?.name) || 'Sin asignar'}</div>
                   </div>
                   <div className="absolute bottom-4 right-4 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity flex gap-2">
                      <button onClick={() => openEdit(emp)} className="p-2 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-700 rounded-lg text-indigo-600 hover:scale-110"><Edit2 size={14}/></button>
                      <button onClick={() => handleDelete(emp.id!)} className="p-2 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-700 rounded-lg text-rose-600 hover:scale-110"><Trash2 size={14}/></button>
                   </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </>
        )}

        {view === 'form' && (
           <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 p-8 rounded-[3rem] border dark:border-slate-700 animate-in slide-in-from-right-4">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-8">
                  <h2 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white uppercase">{isEditing ? 'Editar Legajo' : 'Alta de Personal'}</h2>
                  <button onClick={() => setView('list')} className="text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase text-xs">Cancelar</button>
              </div>

                            {clients.map(c => <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.name || c.razonSocial}</option>)}

                      </div>

                            <option value="">- Sin Asignar -</option>
                            {filteredObjectives.map(o => <option key={o.id} value={o.id}>{o.name}</option>)}
                        </select>
                      </div>
                  </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex justify-end pt-6 border-t dark:border-slate-700">
                 <button onClick={handleSave} className="bg-slate-900 dark:bg-white dark:text-slate-900 text-white px-8 py-3 rounded-xl font-black uppercase text-xs shadow-xl hover:scale-105 transition-transform">Guardar Legajo</button>
              </div>
           </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </DashboardLayout>
  );
}

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import Head from 'next/head';
import { 
  Shield, Users, Clock, AlertTriangle, 
  CheckCircle, Briefcase, MapPin, 
  Activity, ArrowRight, Calendar 
, AlertOctagon } from 'lucide-react';
import DashboardLayout from '@/components/layout/DashboardLayout';
import { withAuthGuard } from '@/components/common/withAuthGuard';
import { db } from '@/lib/firebase';
import { collection, getDocs, query, where, Timestamp } from 'firebase/firestore';

// --- TIPOS ---
interface IDashboardStats {
  coverage: number;
  vacancies: number;
  totalHours: number;
  activeGuards: number;
  totalShifts: number;
}

interface IVacancy {
  id: string;
  client: string;
  objective: string;
  startTime: Date;
  hours: number;
}

interface IClientLoad {
  name: string;
  hours: number;
  percentage: number;
}

// --- COMPONENTES UI (Gráficos CSS Puros) ---
const ProgressBar = ({ value, color = 'bg-indigo-500' }: { value: number, color?: string }) => (
  <div className="w-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-700 rounded-full h-2 mt-2">
    <div className={`h-2 rounded-full ${color}`} style={{ width: `${value}%` }}></div>
  </div>
);

const ActivityHeatmap = ({ hourlyData }: { hourlyData: number[] }) => {
  const max = Math.max(...hourlyData, 1);
  return (
    <div className="flex items-end justify-between h-24 gap-1 mt-4">
      {hourlyData.map((val, i) => (
        <div key={i} className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center group relative">
           {/* Tooltip */}
           <div className="absolute bottom-full mb-1 hidden group-hover:block bg-slate-800 text-white text-[10px] px-2 py-1 rounded whitespace-nowrap z-10">
             {i}:00hs - {val} guardias
           </div>
           {/* Bar */}
           <div 
             className="w-full bg-indigo-200 dark:bg-indigo-900/50 hover:bg-indigo-500 transition-all rounded-t-sm" 
             style={{ height: `${(val / max) * 100}%` }}
           ></div>
           {/* Label */}
           {i % 4 === 0 && <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 mt-1">{i}h</span>}
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
};

function AdminDashboard() {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [stats, setStats] = useState<IDashboardStats>({ coverage: 0, vacancies: 0, totalHours: 0, activeGuards: 0, totalShifts: 0 });
  const [vacanciesList, setVacanciesList] = useState<IVacancy[]>([]);
  const [topClients, setTopClients] = useState<IClientLoad[]>([]);
  const [activityCurve, setActivityCurve] = useState<number[]>(new Array(24).fill(0));
  
  const today = new Date();

  useEffect(() => {
    loadDashboardData();
  }, []);

  const loadDashboardData = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
        // 1. Rango de Fechas: HOY (00:00 a 23:59)
        const start = new Date(); start.setHours(0,0,0,0);
        const end = new Date(); end.setHours(23,59,59,999);
        
        // 2. Cargar Turnos de HOY
        const shiftsQ = query(
            collection(db, 'turnos'), 
            where('startTime', '>=', Timestamp.fromDate(start)), 
            where('startTime', '<=', Timestamp.fromDate(end))
        );
        const shiftsSnap = await getDocs(shiftsQ);
        
        // 3. Procesar Datos
        let totalH = 0;
        let activeEmp = new Set<string>();
        let vacancyCount = 0;
        let vacancies: IVacancy[] = [];
        let clientHours: Record<string, number> = {};
        let hourlyActivity = new Array(24).fill(0);

        // Pre-carga de nombres de clientes (Optimización: Podríamos cargar collection('clients') si son muchos)
        // Por ahora usamos el nombre denormalizado en el turno si existe, o 'Cliente'
        
        shiftsSnap.forEach(doc => {
            const s = doc.data();
            if (s.status === 'Canceled') return;

            const sStart = s.startTime.toDate();
            const sEnd = s.endTime.toDate();
            const duration = (sEnd.getTime() - sStart.getTime()) / 3600000;
            
            // A. Totales
            totalH += duration;
            
            // B. Vacantes vs Activos
            const isVacante = s.employeeId === 'VACANTE' || s.employeeName === 'VACANTE' || !s.employeeId;
            
            if (isVacante) {
                vacancyCount++;
                vacancies.push({
                    id: doc.id,
                    client: s.clientName || 'Cliente', // Asumiendo que guardamos el nombre, si no habría que cruzar
                    objective: s.objectiveName || 'Objetivo',
                    startTime: sStart,
                    hours: duration
                });
            } else {
                activeEmp.add(s.employeeId);
            }

            // C. Por Cliente (Agrupación)
            const cName = s.objectiveName ? s.objectiveName.split('(')[0] : 'General'; // Simplificación visual
            // Idealmente usar s.clientId y cruzar con mapa de clientes, pero para el dashboard rápido usamos lo que hay
            const cleanClient = s.clientId || 'Sin Cliente';
            clientHours[cleanClient] = (clientHours[cleanClient] || 0) + duration;

            // D. Curva de Actividad (Heatmap)
            let temp = new Date(sStart);
            while(temp < sEnd) {
                const h = temp.getHours();
                hourlyActivity[h]++;
                temp.setHours(h + 1);
            }
        });

        // 4. Calcular KPIs Finales
        const totalShifts = shiftsSnap.size;
        const coverage = totalShifts > 0 ? ((totalShifts - vacancyCount) / totalShifts) * 100 : 100;

        // Top Clientes (Necesitamos nombres reales, haremos un fetch rápido de clientes si hay IDs)
        // Para simplificar V1, mostramos los IDs o lo que tengamos
        const sortedClients = Object.entries(clientHours)
            .sort(([,a], [,b]) => b - a)
            .slice(0, 5)
            .map(([name, hours]) => ({
                name: name.substring(0, 15), // Truncar
                hours,
                percentage: (hours / totalH) * 100
            }));

        // Actualizar Estado
        setStats({
            coverage,
            vacancies: vacancyCount,
            totalHours: totalH,
            activeGuards: activeEmp.size,
            totalShifts
        });
        setVacanciesList(vacancies.sort((a,b) => a.startTime.getTime() - b.startTime.getTime()));
        setTopClients(sortedClients);
        setActivityCurve(hourlyActivity);

    } catch (error) {
        console.error("Error loading dashboard", error);
    } finally {
        setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <DashboardLayout>
      <Head><title>Dashboard | CronoApp</title></Head>
      
      <div className="p-6 max-w-7xl mx-auto space-y-6 animate-in fade-in">
        
        {/* HEADER FECHA */}
        <div className="flex justify-between items-end mb-4">
            <div>
                <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 dark:text-white uppercase">Operaciones Hoy</h1>
                <p className="text-slate-500 font-medium flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Calendar size={16}/> {today.toLocaleDateString('es-AR', { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' })}
                </p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
               {/* Aquí podrías poner selector de fecha futuro */}
            </div>
        </div>

        {/* 1. KPIs SUPERIORES */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
            {/* COBERTURA */}
            <div className="p-5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-3xl border dark:border-slate-700 shadow-sm relative overflow-hidden">
                <div className="absolute right-0 top-0 p-4 opacity-5"><Shield size={64}/></div>
                <p className="text-xs font-black text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-1">Cobertura</p>
                <h3 className={`text-3xl font-black ${stats.coverage < 100 ? 'text-amber-500' : 'text-emerald-500'}`}>
                    {stats.coverage.toFixed(1)}%
                </h3>
                <ProgressBar value={stats.coverage} color={stats.coverage < 100 ? 'bg-amber-500' : 'bg-emerald-500'} />
                <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 mt-2 text-right">{stats.totalShifts} turnos tot.</p>
            </div>

            {/* VACANTES */}
            <div className={`p-5 rounded-3xl border shadow-sm relative overflow-hidden ${stats.vacancies > 0 ? 'bg-rose-50 border-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-900/20 dark:border-rose-800' : 'bg-white border-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:border-slate-700'}`}>
                <div className="absolute right-0 top-0 p-4 opacity-5"><AlertTriangle size={64}/></div>
                <p className={`text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest mb-1 ${stats.vacancies > 0 ? 'text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400' : 'text-slate-400'}`}>Vacantes Criticas</p>

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { 
    X, Clock, UserCheck, FastForward, Users, CalendarOff, 
    AlertTriangle, ArrowRight, Phone, MessageCircle, ShieldAlert,
    CheckCircle, UserPlus, Loader2
} from 'lucide-react';
import { db } from '@/lib/firebase';
import { collection, query, where, getDocs, Timestamp, updateDoc, doc, serverTimestamp, addDoc } from 'firebase/firestore';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

// Helper para mostrar contactos rápidamente
const ContactButton = ({ phone, name }: { phone: string, name: string }) => {
    if (!phone) return <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Sin tel.</span>;
    const clean = phone.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');
    return (
        <div className="flex gap-2">
            <a href={`tel:${clean}`} className="p-1.5 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 rounded text-slate-600" title="Llamar"><Phone size={14}/></a>
            <a href={`https://wa.me/${clean}`} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" className="p-1.5 bg-emerald-100 hover:bg-emerald-200 rounded text-emerald-600" title="WhatsApp"><MessageCircle size={14}/></a>
        </div>
    );
};

interface Props {
    isOpen: boolean;
    onClose: () => void; // Cierra sin resolver (Resolver más tarde)
    absenceShift: any;   // El turno que generó la ausencia (el problema)
    onResolve: () => void; // Cierra resolviendo (desaparece de la lista)
}

export default function AbsenceResolutionModal({ isOpen, onClose, absenceShift, onResolve }: Props) {
    // ESTADOS DE LA MAQUINA DE ESTADOS (WIZARD)
    const [step, setStep] = useState<'LOADING' | 'MENU' | 'SELECT_RETAIN' | 'SELECT_ADVANCE' | 'SEARCH_SUB'>('LOADING');
    
    // Contexto Operativo
    const [currentShifts, setCurrentShifts] = useState<any[]>([]); // Guardias presentes AHORA
    const [nextShifts, setNextShifts] = useState<any[]>([]);       // Guardias que vienen DESPUES
    const [loadingAction, setLoadingAction] = useState(false);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (isOpen && absenceShift) {
            analyzeOperationalContext();
        }
    }, [isOpen, absenceShift]);

    // 1. ANÁLISIS DE CONTEXTO (INTELIGENCIA)
    const analyzeOperationalContext = async () => {
        setStep('LOADING');
        try {
            const now = new Date();
            // Ventana de "Actuales": Turnos que terminan dentro de las próximas 2 horas o ya terminaron hace poco pero siguen activos
            // (Simplificación: Buscamos quienes deberían estar ahí ahora excluyendo al ausente)
            
            // NOTA: En una app real, esto debería ser más robusto con las fechas, 
            // aquí asumimos que 'isPresent' es la verdad absoluta.
            const qCurrent = query(
                collection(db, 'turnos'),
                where('objectiveId', '==', absenceShift.objectiveId),
                where('isPresent', '==', true), 
                where('isCompleted', '==', false)
            );

            // Ventana de "Próximos": Turnos que empiezan en las próximas 12 horas
            const nextWindowEnd = new Date(now.getTime() + 12 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
            const qNext = query(
                collection(db, 'turnos'),
                where('objectiveId', '==', absenceShift.objectiveId),
                where('startTime', '>=', Timestamp.fromDate(now)),
                where('startTime', '<=', Timestamp.fromDate(nextWindowEnd))
            );

            const [currSnap, nextSnap] = await Promise.all([getDocs(qCurrent), getDocs(qNext)]);

            // Filtramos para asegurarnos que no nos traemos al propio ausente (por si acaso)
            const current = currSnap.docs.map(d => ({id: d.id, ...d.data()})).filter((s:any) => s.id !== absenceShift.id);
            const next = nextSnap.docs.map(d => ({id: d.id, ...d.data()})).filter((s:any) => s.id !== absenceShift.id);

            setCurrentShifts(current);
            setNextShifts(next);
            setStep('MENU');
        } catch (e) {
            console.error(e);
            toast.error("Error analizando disponibilidad operativa.");
            setStep('MENU'); // Fallback para permitir cerrar
        }
    };

    // 2. LÓGICA DE RETENCIÓN (RETAIN)
    const handleRetainFlow = () => {
        if (currentShifts.length === 0) {
            toast.warning("No hay guardias presentes en el objetivo para retener.");
            return;
        }
        if (currentShifts.length === 1) {
            // Solo uno, ejecutamos directo (con confirmación implícita en el click)
            executeRetain(currentShifts[0]);
        } else {
            // Hay más de uno (ej: pareja de guardia), hay que elegir a quién
            setStep('SELECT_RETAIN');
        }
    };

    const executeRetain = async (guardShift: any) => {
        setLoadingAction(true);
        try {
            // A. Extender el turno del guardia actual
            // Calculamos hasta cuándo: idealmente hasta el fin del turno ausente
            const coverUntil = absenceShift.endDateObj || new Date(new Date().getTime() + 8*60*60*1000); 

            await updateDoc(doc(db, 'turnos', guardShift.id), {
                endTime: Timestamp.fromDate(coverUntil), // Extendemos su hora de salida
                isRetention: true,
                isExtended: true,
                comments: `RETENCIÓN: Cubre ausencia de ${absenceShift.employeeName}`
            });

            // B. Resolver la ausencia
            await resolveAbsence('RETENTION', `Cubierto por retención de ${guardShift.employeeName} (Leg: ${guardShift.fileNumber})`);
        } catch(e) { 
            console.error(e);
            toast.error("Error al procesar retención"); 
            setLoadingAction(false);
        }
    };

    // 3. LÓGICA DE ADELANTO (ADVANCE)
    const handleAdvanceFlow = () => {
        if (nextShifts.length === 0) {
            toast.warning("No hay turnos programados próximamente para adelantar.");
            return;
        }
        if (nextShifts.length === 1) {
            executeAdvance(nextShifts[0]);
        } else {
            setStep('SELECT_ADVANCE');
        }
    };

    const executeAdvance = async (guardShift: any) => {
        setLoadingAction(true);
        try {
            // A. Traer la hora de inicio a "YA MISMO"
            await updateDoc(doc(db, 'turnos', guardShift.id), {
                startTime: serverTimestamp(), // Empieza ahora
                isEarlyEntry: true,
                entryNote: `ADELANTO: Cubre ausencia de ${absenceShift.employeeName}`
            });
            
            // B. Resolver la ausencia
            await resolveAbsence('ADVANCE', `Cubierto por adelanto de turno: ${guardShift.employeeName}`);
        } catch(e) { 
            console.error(e);
            toast.error("Error al procesar adelanto"); 
            setLoadingAction(false);
        }
    };

    // 4. RESOLUCIÓN FINAL COMÚN
    const resolveAbsence = async (method: string, note: string) => {
        // Marcamos el turno conflictivo como resuelto para que desaparezca de la lista de pendientes
        await updateDoc(doc(db, 'turnos', absenceShift.id), {
            resolutionStatus: 'RESOLVED',
            resolutionMethod: method,
            resolutionNote: note,
            resolvedAt: serverTimestamp()
        });
        
        // Opcional: Crear un registro en "Bitácora" o "Historial"
        await addDoc(collection(db, 'historial_resoluciones'), {
            originalShiftId: absenceShift.id,
            method,
            note,
            timestamp: serverTimestamp()
        });

        toast.success("✅ Incidencia Resuelta Exitosamente");
        onResolve(); // Llama al padre para refrescar
    };

    // RENDERIZADO DE LISTAS DE SELECCIÓN
    const renderSelectionList = (list: any[], action: (s:any)=>void, title: string, subtitle: string) => (
        <div className="space-y-4 animate-in slide-in-from-right">
            <div className="bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200">
                <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-700 text-sm flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                    <Users size={16}/> {title}
                </h4>
                <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">{subtitle}</p>
            </div>
            
            <div className="space-y-2">
                {list.map(s => (
                    <button 
                        key={s.id} 
                        onClick={() => action(s)} 
                        disabled={loadingAction}
                        className="w-full p-4 border border-slate-200 hover:border-indigo-500 hover:bg-indigo-50/50 rounded-xl cursor-pointer bg-white transition-all flex justify-between items-center group text-left"
                    >
                        <div>
                            <p className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-800">{s.employeeName}</p>
                            <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 flex items-center gap-1">
                                {s.phone ? <span className="text-emerald-600 font-mono">{s.phone}</span> : 'Sin tel'}
                            </p>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                             <ContactButton phone={s.phone} name={s.employeeName} />
                             <ArrowRight className="text-slate-300 group-hover:text-indigo-500" size={18}/>
                        </div>
                    </button>
                ))}
            </div>
            <button onClick={() => setStep('MENU')} className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 w-full text-center mt-4">VOLVER AL MENÚ</button>
        </div>
    );

    if (!isOpen) return null;

    return (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[9000] bg-black/60 flex items-center justify-center p-4 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in">
            <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 w-full max-w-md rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden border dark:border-slate-800 flex flex-col max-h-[90vh]">
                
                {/* HEADER */}
                <div className="bg-slate-900 p-5 flex justify-between items-start shrink-0">
                    <div>
                        <h3 className="font-black text-lg text-white flex items-center gap-2">
                            <ShieldAlert className="text-rose-500"/> GESTIÓN DE INCIDENCIA
                        </h3>
                        <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs mt-1">Objetivo: <span className="text-white font-bold">{absenceShift.objectiveName}</span></p>
                    </div>
                    <button onClick={onClose} className="p-2 hover:bg-white/10 rounded-full text-white/70 hover:text-white transition-colors">
                        <X size={20}/>
                    </button>
                </div>

                {/* BODY */}
                <div className="p-6 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar flex-1">
                    
                    {step === 'LOADING' && (
                        <div className="h-40 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-slate-400 gap-3">
                            <Loader2 className="animate-spin text-indigo-500" size={32}/>
                            <p className="text-xs font-medium animate-pulse">Analizando contexto operativo...</p>
                        </div>
                    )}

                    {step === 'MENU' && (
                        <div className="space-y-3 animate-in zoom-in-95">
                            {/* ESTADO SITUACIONAL */}
                            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 mb-2">
                                <div className={`p-3 rounded-xl border flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center ${currentShifts.length > 0 ? 'bg-indigo-50 border-indigo-200 text-indigo-700' : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 text-slate-400'}`}>
                                    <span className="text-2xl font-black">{currentShifts.length}</span>
                                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase">Guardias en Sitio</span>
                                </div>
                                <div className={`p-3 rounded-xl border flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center ${nextShifts.length > 0 ? 'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200 text-emerald-700' : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 text-slate-400'}`}>
                                    <span className="text-2xl font-black">{nextShifts.length}</span>
                                    <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase">Próximo Turno</span>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <p className="text-xs font-black text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Acciones de Cobertura</p>

                            {/* OPCION 1: RETENER */}
                            <button 
                                onClick={handleRetainFlow}
                                disabled={currentShifts.length === 0}
                                className={`w-full p-4 rounded-xl border text-left flex items-center justify-between group transition-all ${currentShifts.length > 0 ? 'bg-white border-slate-200 hover:border-orange-500 hover:shadow-md' : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-100 opacity-60 cursor-not-allowed'}`}
                            >
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                                    <div className={`p-3 rounded-xl ${currentShifts.length > 0 ? 'bg-orange-100 text-orange-600' : 'bg-slate-200 text-slate-400'}`}>
                                        <Clock size={20}/>
                                    </div>
                                    <div>
                                        <p className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-800">Retener Guardia Actual</p>
                                        <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">Extender horario al personal saliente.</p>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                {currentShifts.length > 0 && <ArrowRight size={18} className="text-slate-300 group-hover:text-orange-500"/>}
                            </button>

                            {/* OPCION 2: ADELANTAR */}
                            <button 
                                onClick={handleAdvanceFlow}
                                disabled={nextShifts.length === 0}
                                className={`w-full p-4 rounded-xl border text-left flex items-center justify-between group transition-all ${nextShifts.length > 0 ? 'bg-white border-slate-200 hover:border-indigo-500 hover:shadow-md' : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-100 opacity-60 cursor-not-allowed'}`}
                            >
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                                    <div className={`p-3 rounded-xl ${nextShifts.length > 0 ? 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-600' : 'bg-slate-200 text-slate-400'}`}>
                                        <FastForward size={20}/>
                                    </div>
                                    <div>
                                        <p className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-800">Adelantar Turno Siguiente</p>
                                        <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">Llamar al relevo para ingreso inmediato.</p>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                                {nextShifts.length > 0 && <ArrowRight size={18} className="text-slate-300 group-hover:text-indigo-500"/>}
                            </button>

                            {/* OPCION 3: BUSCAR FRANCO (Placeholder) */}
                            <button 
                                onClick={() => toast.info("Módulo de búsqueda de Francos en desarrollo")}
                                className="w-full p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:border-emerald-500 hover:shadow-md text-left flex items-center justify-between group transition-all"
                            >
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                                    <div className="p-3 rounded-xl bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-600">
                                        <UserPlus size={20}/>
                                    </div>
                                    <div>
                                        <p className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-800">Cubrir con Franco</p>
                                        <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500">Buscar personal disponible en la zona.</p>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            </button>

                        </div>
                    )}

                    {step === 'SELECT_RETAIN' && renderSelectionList(
                        currentShifts, 
                        executeRetain, 
                        "Seleccione Guardia para Retener", 
                        "Hay múltiples empleados activos en el objetivo. ¿Quién cubrirá?"
                    )}

                    {step === 'SELECT_ADVANCE' && renderSelectionList(
                        nextShifts, 
                        executeAdvance, 
                        "Seleccione Guardia para Adelantar", 
                        "Hay múltiples empleados programados. ¿A quién llamará?"
                    )}

                </div>

                {/* FOOTER */}
                <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 border-t border-slate-200 flex justify-end">
                    <button onClick={onClose} className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 hover:text-slate-600 uppercase transition-colors">
                        Resolver más tarde
                    </button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}

const formatTime = (dateObj: any) => {
    if (!dateObj) return '--:--';
    const date = dateObj.toDate ? dateObj.toDate() : new Date(dateObj);
    return isNaN(date.getTime()) ? '--:--' : date.toLocaleTimeString('es-AR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
};

// --- COMPONENTE DE ACCIÓN RÁPIDA DE CONTACTO ---
const ContactActions = ({ phone, name }: { phone: string, name: string }) => {
    if (!phone) return <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 italic">Sin tel.</span>;
    const cleanPhone = phone.replace(/[^0-9]/g, '');

        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
            <a href={`tel:${cleanPhone}`} className="p-1.5 bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 rounded-lg hover:bg-slate-200 transition-colors" title={`Llamar a ${name}`}>
                <Phone size={12}/>
            </a>
            <button onClick={() => window.open(`https://wa.me/${cleanPhone}`, '_blank')} className="p-1.5 bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-600 rounded-lg hover:bg-emerald-200 transition-colors" title="WhatsApp">
                <MessageCircle size={12}/>
            </button>

const ExternalMapWindow = ({ children, onClose }: any) => {
    const [containerEl, setContainerEl] = useState<HTMLElement | null>(null);
    React.useEffect(() => {
        if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
        const windowName = `MapaOperativo_${Date.now()}`;
        const newWindow = window.open('', windowName, 'width=1200,height=800,left=200,top=200');
        if (!newWindow) { alert("⚠️ Ventana bloqueada. Habilita pop-ups."); onClose(); return; }
        newWindow.document.title = "Monitor de Operaciones - Mapa";
        const styles = document.querySelectorAll('style, link[rel="stylesheet"]');
        styles.forEach(node => newWindow.document.head.appendChild(node.cloneNode(true)));
        const popupStyle = newWindow.document.createElement('style');
        popupStyle.innerHTML = POPUP_STYLES;
        newWindow.document.head.appendChild(popupStyle);
        if (document.documentElement.classList.contains('dark')) { newWindow.document.documentElement.classList.add('dark'); }
        newWindow.document.body.className = "bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-900 m-0 p-0 overflow-hidden";
        const div = newWindow.document.createElement('div');
        div.id = 'external-root';
        div.style.height = '100%';
        div.style.width = '100%';
        newWindow.document.body.appendChild(div);
        setContainerEl(div);
        const checkClosed = setInterval(() => { if (newWindow.closed) { clearInterval(checkClosed); onClose(); } }, 500);
        return () => { clearInterval(checkClosed); if (newWindow && !newWindow.closed) { newWindow.close(); } };
    }, []);
    if (!containerEl) return null;
    return createPortal(children, containerEl);
};

'text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-600 decoration-slate-300 dark:decoration-slate-600 line-through' : 'text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200'}`}>{shift.employeeName}</span><div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[9px] text-slate-400 truncate"><Briefcase size={9} /> {shift.clientName} <span className="text-slate-300 dark:text-slate-600">|</span> {style.label}</div></div>

(<button onClick={() => onAction('CHECKIN', shift.id)} disabled={isProcessing} title="Dar Presente" className="p-1.5 bg-indigo-50 dark:bg-indigo-900/30 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 rounded hover:bg-indigo-600 hover:text-white transition-colors"><CheckCircle size={14} /></button>) : (<button onClick={() => onAction('CHECKOUT', shift.id)} disabled={isProcessing} title="Finalizar" className="p-1.5 bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-900/30 text-purple-600 dark:text-purple-400 rounded hover:bg-purple-600 hover:text-white transition-colors"><LogOut size={14} /></button>)}<button onClick={() => onAction('NOVEDAD', shift.id)} title="Novedad" className="p-1.5 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-700 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 rounded hover:bg-rose-50 hover:text-rose-600 transition-colors"><AlertTriangle size={14} /></button></>)}

            <div className="pl-2 flex justify-between items-start mb-1">
                 <div className="flex flex-col"><span className={`text-[9px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider w-fit px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded mb-1 ${style.badge}`}>{style.label}</span><h4 className={`font-bold text-sm leading-tight truncate flex items-center gap-1 ${shift.isCompleted && !shift.isAbsent && !isRetention ? 'text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-600' : 'text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100'}`}>{shift.employeeName}</h4></div>
                 <div className="text-right"><div className="text-[11px] font-black font-mono text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300 bg-white/50 dark:bg-black/20 px-1 rounded">{formatTime(shift.shiftDateObj)}</div><div className="text-[9px] text-slate-400">a {formatTime(shift.endDateObj)}</div></div>

                {shift.isAbsent && (<div className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-rose-700 dark:text-rose-300 bg-white/60 dark:bg-black/20 p-2 rounded border border-rose-200 dark:border-rose-900 italic flex items-start gap-2"><UserX size={12} className="mt-0.5 shrink-0"/>{shift.comments || "Ausencia sin aviso registrado."}</div>)}
                {(shift.isEarlyEntry || shift.isCoverage) && (<div className="mt-1.5 text-[10px] text-blue-700 dark:text-blue-300 bg-blue-100/50 dark:bg-blue-900/30 border border-blue-100 dark:border-blue-900/50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md inline-block font-medium">Info: {shift.coverageNote || shift.entryNote || "Cobertura operativa"}</div>)}
                {isRetention && (<div className="mt-1.5 text-[10px] text-orange-700 dark:text-orange-200 bg-orange-100/50 dark:bg-orange-900/30 border border-orange-200 dark:border-orange-800 px-2 py-1 rounded-md font-bold flex items-center gap-1"><Siren size={10} className="animate-bounce"/> Relevo pendiente. No abandonar puesto.</div>)}
            </div>
            {(!readOnly || isRetention || isConflict || shift.isAbsent) && !shift.isCompleted && (
                <div className="pl-2 mt-3 pt-2 border-t border-slate-200/50 dark:border-slate-700/50 flex gap-2">
                    {(isConflict || isRetention) ? (<button onClick={handleResolution} className="flex-1 py-1.5 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold uppercase shadow-md flex items-center justify-center gap-2 animate-pulse"><Siren size={14}/> {isRetention ? 'GESTIONAR RETENCIÓN' : 'RESOLVER INCIDENCIA'}</button>) : (<>{!shift.isPresent && !shift.isAbsent ? (<button onClick={() => onAction('CHECKIN', shift.id)} disabled={isProcessing} className="flex-1 py-1.5 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold uppercase flex items-center justify-center gap-2 hover:bg-indigo-700 transition-colors"><CheckCircle size={12}/> LLEGADA</button>) : (<button onClick={() => onAction('CHECKOUT', shift.id)} disabled={isProcessing} className="flex-1 py-1.5 bg-purple-600 text-white rounded-lg text-[10px] font-bold uppercase flex items-center justify-center gap-2 hover:bg-purple-700 transition-colors"><LogOut size={12}/> SALIDA</button>)}<button onClick={() => onAction('NOVEDAD', shift.id)} className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-500 rounded-lg hover:bg-rose-50 hover:text-rose-600 transition-colors"><AlertTriangle size={14}/></button></>)}
                    
                    {/* BOTONES DE CONTACTO EN LA TARJETA */}
                    <div className="flex gap-1">
                        <button onClick={() => window.open(`tel:${shift.phone?.replace(/[^0-9]/g,'') || ''}`)} className="p-2 bg-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-200 rounded-lg text-slate-500 transition-colors" title="Llamar"><Phone size={14}/></button>
                        <button onClick={handleWhatsApp} className="p-2 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-100 text-emerald-600 rounded-lg hover:bg-emerald-600 hover:text-white transition-colors" title="WhatsApp"><MessageCircle size={14}/></button>
                    </div>
                </div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
};

export default function OperacionesPage() {
    const logic = useOperacionesMonitor();
    const [isExternalMap, setIsExternalMap] = useState(false);
    const [mapInstance, setMapInstance] = useState<any>(null);
    const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false); 
    
    // ESTADOS PARA MODAL Y MINIMIZADOS
    const [resolutionModal, setResolutionModal] = useState<{isOpen: boolean, shift: any | null, prevShift: any | null, step: number}>({isOpen: false, shift: null, prevShift: null, step: 1});
    const [minimizedResolutions, setMinimizedResolutions] = useState<any[]>([]);

    const handleLlegoAhora = async () => {
        if (!resolutionModal.shift) return;
        setIsProcessing(true);
        try {
            await logic.handleAction('CHECKIN', resolutionModal.shift.id);
            toast.success("Ingreso registrado");
            setResolutionModal(prev => ({ ...prev, isOpen: false })); // CERRAR MODAL
        } catch(e) { toast.error("Error al registrar ingreso"); } finally { setIsProcessing(false); }
    };

    const openResolution = async (shift: any) => {
        // Verificar si ya está minimizado
        const isMinimized = minimizedResolutions.find(m => m.shift.id === shift.id);
        if (isMinimized) {
            setResolutionModal({ isOpen: true, shift: isMinimized.shift, prevShift: isMinimized.prevShift, step: isMinimized.step });
            setMinimizedResolutions(prev => prev.filter(m => m.shift.id !== shift.id)); // Sacar de minimizados
            return;
        }

        const candidates = logic.processedData.filter((s:any) => s.objectiveId === shift.objectiveId && s.id !== shift.id && s.status !== 'ABSENT');
        
        // --- FIX: ORDENAMIENTO SEGURO ---
        candidates.sort((a:any, b:any) => {
             const endA = a.endDateObj || a.visualEndDateObj || new Date();
             const endB = b.endDateObj || b.visualEndDateObj || new Date();
             return endB.getTime() - endA.getTime();
        });

        const prevShift = candidates.find((s:any) => {
             // --- FIX: COMPARACIÓN SEGURA ---
             const endS = s.endDateObj || s.visualEndDateObj || new Date();
             const timeDiff = shift.shiftDateObj.getTime() - endS.getTime();
             return timeDiff >= -900000 && timeDiff < 14400000; 
        });
        
        // Si el turno ya está ausente o retenido, abrimos en el paso correspondiente
        let initialStep = 1;
        if (shift.status === 'ABSENT' || shift.isAbsent) initialStep = 3; // Ya confirmado, buscar reemplazo

        setResolutionModal({ isOpen: true, shift, prevShift, step: initialStep });
    };

    const minimizeModal = () => {
        if (resolutionModal.shift) {
            setMinimizedResolutions(prev => [...prev, { ...resolutionModal }]);
            setResolutionModal(prev => ({ ...prev, isOpen: false }));
        }
    };

    // PASO 2: Confirmar Ausencia y Retener Automáticamente
    const confirmAbsenceAndRetain = async (reason: string) => {
        if (!resolutionModal.shift) return;
        setIsProcessing(true);
        try {
            const batch = []; // Aquí usaríamos writeBatch si tuviéramos acceso a firebase/firestore directo
            
            // 1. Marcar Ausente
            await updateDoc(doc(db, 'turnos', resolutionModal.shift.id), { status: 'ABSENT', isAbsent: true, comments: reason });
            await addDoc(collection(db, 'novedades'), { type: 'AUSENCIA', employeeId: resolutionModal.shift.employeeId, details: reason, createdAt: serverTimestamp() });
            
            // 2. Retener al anterior (si existe)
            if (resolutionModal.prevShift) {
                await updateDoc(doc(db, 'turnos', resolutionModal.prevShift.id), { 
                    isRetention: true, 
                    status: 'PRESENT', 
                    endTime: null, 
                    retentionStartTime: serverTimestamp(), 
                    comments: 'RETENCIÓN ACTIVA: Esperando relevo.' 
                });
                toast.success("Ausencia Confirmada. PROTOCOLO DE RETENCIÓN ACTIVADO.");
            } else {
                toast.warning("Ausencia Confirmada. No se encontró guardia previo para retener.");
            }

            // 3. Avanzar al paso de cobertura
            setResolutionModal(prev => ({ ...prev, step: 3 }));

        } catch (e) { toast.error("Error al procesar"); } finally { setIsProcessing(false); }
    };

    // Liberar retenido manualmente (si hace falta)
    const stopRetention = async () => {
        if (!resolutionModal.prevShift) return;
        try { await updateDoc(doc(db, 'turnos', resolutionModal.prevShift.id), { isRetention: false, isExtended: true, endTime: serverTimestamp(), status: 'COMPLETED', comments: 'Retención finalizada.' }); toast.success("⏹️ Retención Finalizada."); setResolutionModal({ ...resolutionModal, isOpen: false }); } catch (e) { toast.error("Error"); }
    };
    
    const handleAdelantarSiguiente = async () => { toast.info("Funcionalidad: Adelantar turno siguiente"); };

    const countRetencion = logic.processedData.filter((s:any) => s.isRetention).length;
    const countPrioridad = logic.listData.length; 
    const countActivos = logic.processedData.filter((s:any) => s.isPresent).length; 
    const countHoy = logic.processedData.length;

    return (
        <DashboardLayout>
            <Toaster position="top-right" />
            <Head><title>Operaciones | Monitor</title></Head>
            <style>{POPUP_STYLES}</style>

            <div className="h-[calc(100vh-100px)] flex flex-col lg:flex-row gap-4 p-2 animate-in fade-in relative">
                {!isExternalMap && (
                    <div className="flex-1 lg:flex-[3] bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 overflow-hidden relative shadow-inner z-10">
                        <OperacionesMap 
                            center={[-31.4201, -64.1888]} 
                            objectives={logic.objectives} 
                            processedData={logic.processedData} 
                            onAction={logic.handleAction} 
                            setMapInstance={setMapInstance} 
                            onOpenResolution={openResolution} 
                        />
                        <button onClick={() => setIsExternalMap(true)} className="absolute top-4 right-4 z-[1000] bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-2 rounded-lg shadow-lg hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700" title="Ventana Flotante"><ExternalLink size={20}/></button>
                        <div className="absolute bottom-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-[1000] pointer-events-none">
                            <div className="bg-white/95 dark:bg-slate-900/95 backdrop-blur shadow-2xl rounded-full px-6 py-2 flex gap-8 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 pointer-events-auto items-center">
                                {countRetencion > 0 && (<><div className="text-center animate-pulse"><div className="text-xl font-black text-orange-600 leading-none">{countRetencion}</div><div className="text-[8px] font-bold text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">RETENIDOS</div></div><div className="h-6 w-px bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700"></div></>)}
                                <div className="text-center"><div className="text-xl font-black text-rose-500 leading-none">{countPrioridad}</div><div className="text-[8px] font-bold text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Alertas</div></div>
                                <div className="h-6 w-px bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700"></div>
                                <div className="text-center"><div className="text-xl font-black text-emerald-600 leading-none">{countActivos}</div><div className="text-[8px] font-bold text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider">Activos</div></div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                )}
                {isExternalMap && (<ExternalMapWindow onClose={() => setIsExternalMap(false)}><div className="h-full w-full relative"><OperacionesMap center={[-31.4201, -64.1888]} objectives={logic.objectives} processedData={logic.processedData} onAction={logic.handleAction} setMapInstance={setMapInstance} isExternal={true} onOpenResolution={openResolution} /></div></ExternalMapWindow>)}
                
                <div className={`bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-3xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 flex flex-col overflow-hidden shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 ${isExternalMap ? 'flex-1 w-full' : 'flex-1 lg:flex-[2]'}`}>
                    <div className="p-4 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950/50 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800">
                        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4"><h2 className="text-lg font-black text-slate-800 dark:text-white flex items-center gap-2"><Radio className="text-rose-600 animate-pulse" /> RADIO</h2><div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg px-2 py-1 text-xs font-mono text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 shadow-sm">{logic.now.toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'})}</div></div>
                        <div className="flex p-1 bg-slate-200/50 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded-xl mb-3 gap-1">
                            <button onClick={() => logic.setViewTab('PRIORIDAD')} className={`flex-1 py-2 text-[10px] font-black uppercase rounded-lg transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1 ${logic.viewTab === 'PRIORIDAD' ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-700 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 shadow-md ring-1 ring-black/5 dark:ring-white/10' : 'text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-300'}`}><Siren size={14}/> Prioridad ({countPrioridad})</button>
                            <button onClick={() => logic.setViewTab('ACTIVOS')} className={`flex-1 py-2 text-[10px] font-black uppercase rounded-lg transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1 ${logic.viewTab === 'ACTIVOS' ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-700 text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400 shadow-md ring-1 ring-black/5 dark:ring-white/10' : 'text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-300'}`}><CheckCircle size={14}/> Activos ({countActivos})</button>
                            <button onClick={() => logic.setViewTab('HOY')} className={`flex-1 py-2 text-[10px] font-black uppercase rounded-lg transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1 ${logic.viewTab === 'HOY' ? 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-700 text-indigo-600 dark:text-indigo-400 shadow-md ring-1 ring-black/5 dark:ring-white/10' : 'text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-300'}`}><Calendar size={14}/> Hoy ({countHoy})</button>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex gap-2 items-center mt-3">
                             <div className="relative flex-1"><Search className="absolute left-3 top-2.5 text-slate-400" size={16}/><input className="w-full bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 pl-9 pr-3 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold uppercase focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 outline-none transition-all dark:text-white" placeholder="BUSCAR..." value={logic.filterText} onChange={(e) => logic.setFilterText(e.target.value)} /></div>
                             <button onClick={() => logic.setIsCompact(!logic.isCompact)} className={`p-2 rounded-xl border transition-all ${logic.isCompact ? 'bg-indigo-100 dark:bg-indigo-900/40 text-indigo-700 dark:text-indigo-300 border-indigo-200 dark:border-indigo-800' : 'bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 text-slate-400 dark:text-slate-500 border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 hover:text-slate-600 dark:hover:text-slate-300'}`} title={logic.isCompact ? "Vista Expandida" : "Vista Compacta"}>{logic.isCompact ? <Maximize2 size={18} /> : <Minimize2 size={18} />}</button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-3 space-y-2 bg-slate-50/30 dark:bg-slate-950/30 custom-scrollbar relative">
                        {logic.listData.length === 0 ? <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full w-full col-span-full text-slate-400 opacity-60"><ListFilter size={48} className="mb-2"/><p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase">Sin datos en esta vista</p></div> : logic.listData.map((s:any) => {
                            let type = 'PENDING';
                            if (s.isLate) type = 'LATE'; else if (s.isImminent) type = 'IMMINENT'; else if (s.isPresent) type = 'ACTIVE';
                            return <GuardCard key={s.id} shift={s} statusType={type} onAction={logic.handleAction} isProcessing={logic.processingId === s.id} readOnly={logic.viewTab === 'HOY' && s.isCompleted} isCompact={logic.isCompact} onOpenResolution={openResolution} />;
                        })}
                    </div>
                    <div className="h-40 border-t border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 flex flex-col">
                        <div className="px-4 py-2 border-b border-slate-100 dark:border-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2"><ClipboardList size={14} className="text-slate-400"/><h3 className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">Bitácora del Día</h3></div>
                        <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto custom-scrollbar p-0">
                            {logic.recentLogs.length === 0 ? <p className="text-center text-[10px] text-slate-300 italic py-4">Sin actividad reciente</p> : (
                                <table className="w-full text-[10px] text-left"><tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-50 dark:divide-slate-800">{logic.recentLogs.map((log:any) => (<tr key={log.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/50"><td className="px-4 py-2 font-mono text-slate-400 w-16">{log.time ? formatTime(log.time) : '--:--'}</td><td className="px-2 py-2 w-24"><span className={`px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-bold uppercase text-[8px] border ${log.type === 'NOVEDAD' ? 'bg-orange-50 dark:bg-orange-900/20 text-orange-600 dark:text-orange-400 border-orange-100 dark:border-orange-900/30' : 'bg-rose-50 dark:bg-rose-900/20 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 border-rose-100 dark:border-rose-900/30'}`}>{log.type}</span></td><td className="px-2 py-2 font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 truncate max-w-[100px]">{log.emp}</td><td className="px-2 py-2 text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400 truncate max-w-[150px]">{log.title}: {log.desc}</td></tr>))}</tbody></table>
                            )}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            {/* --- DOCK DE TAREAS MINIMIZADAS --- */}
            <div className="fixed bottom-4 right-4 z-[8000] flex flex-col gap-2 items-end">
                {minimizedResolutions.map((item, idx) => (
                    <div key={idx} onClick={() => {
                        setResolutionModal(item);
                        setMinimizedResolutions(prev => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== idx));
                    }} className="bg-slate-900 text-white p-3 rounded-xl shadow-2xl cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-800 transition-all flex items-center gap-3 animate-in slide-in-from-bottom border border-slate-700">
                        <div className="relative">
                            <Siren className="text-rose-500 animate-pulse" size={20}/>
                            <span className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 flex h-3 w-3"><span className="animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full bg-rose-400 opacity-75"></span><span className="relative inline-flex rounded-full h-3 w-3 bg-rose-500"></span></span>
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase">Incidencia Pendiente</p>
                            <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">{item.shift?.employeeName}</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                ))}
            </div>

            {/* RESOLUCIÓN MODAL MEJORADO (MINIMIZABLE + PASOS) */}
            {resolutionModal.isOpen && resolutionModal.shift && (
                <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[7000] bg-black/80 flex items-center justify-center backdrop-blur-md p-4 animate-in zoom-in-95">
                    <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 w-full max-w-2xl rounded-3xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden flex flex-col max-h-[90vh] border dark:border-slate-800">
                        <div className="bg-slate-900 p-6 flex justify-between items-start">
                            <div><h3 className="font-black text-xl text-white flex items-center gap-2"><Siren className="text-rose-500 animate-pulse"/> RESOLUCIÓN DE CONFLICTO</h3><p className="text-slate-400 text-xs mt-1">Objetivo: <span className="font-bold text-white">{resolutionModal.shift.objectiveName}</span></p></div>
                            <div className="flex gap-2">
                                <button onClick={minimizeModal} className="p-2 hover:bg-white/10 rounded-full text-white" title="Minimizar y resolver luego"><Minus size={20}/></button>
                                <button onClick={() => setResolutionModal(p => ({...p, isOpen: false}))} className="p-2 hover:bg-white/10 rounded-full text-white"><X size={20}/></button>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        
                        <div className="p-6 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950 overflow-y-auto">
                            
                            {/* PASO 1: DIAGNÓSTICO */}
                            {resolutionModal.step === 1 && (
                                <div className="space-y-6">
                                    <div className="p-4 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-sm">
                                        <p className="text-xs font-black uppercase text-slate-400 mb-2">Guardia Entrante (Problema)</p>
                                        <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                                            <h2 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-800">{resolutionModal.shift.employeeName}</h2>
                                            <ContactActions phone={resolutionModal.shift.phone} name={resolutionModal.shift.employeeName}/>
                                        </div>
                                        <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">Hora de ingreso: {formatTime(resolutionModal.shift.shiftDateObj)}</p>
                                    </div>

                                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                                        <button onClick={handleLlegoAhora} disabled={isProcessing} className="p-6 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 rounded-2xl hover:bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 flex flex-col items-center gap-2 transition-all">
                                            <CheckCircle size={32}/> 
                                            <span className="font-black text-sm uppercase">{isProcessing ? <Loader2 className="animate-spin"/> : 'LLEGÓ AHORA'}</span>
                                            <span className="text-[10px]">Cerrar incidencia</span>
                                        </button>
                                        <button onClick={() => confirmAbsenceAndRetain('Ausencia sin aviso')} disabled={isProcessing} className="p-6 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 rounded-2xl hover:bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 flex flex-col items-center gap-2 transition-all">
                                            <UserX size={32}/> 
                                            <span className="font-black text-sm uppercase">CONFIRMAR AUSENCIA</span>
                                            <span className="text-[10px]">Activar Protocolo Retención</span>
                                        </button>
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            )}

                            {/* PASO 3: RESOLUCIÓN Y COBERTURA */}
                            {resolutionModal.step === 3 && (
                                <div className="space-y-6">
                                    {/* ALERTA DE RETENCIÓN */}
                                    <div className="p-4 bg-orange-50 border-l-4 border-orange-500 rounded-r-xl shadow-sm">
                                        <div className="flex justify-between items-start">
                                            <div>
                                                <h4 className="font-black text-orange-800 flex items-center gap-2 uppercase"><ShieldAlert size={18}/> Retención Activa</h4>
                                                <p className="text-xs text-orange-700 mt-1">El guardia saliente debe permanecer en el puesto hasta el relevo.</p>
                                            </div>
                                            {resolutionModal.prevShift && <ContactActions phone={resolutionModal.prevShift.phone} name={resolutionModal.prevShift.employeeName}/>}
                                        </div>
                                        {resolutionModal.prevShift && (
                                            <div className="mt-3 text-sm font-bold text-slate-700">
                                                Guardia Retenido: {resolutionModal.prevShift.employeeName}
                                                <p className="text-[10px] font-normal text-slate-500 mt-1">* Acumula horas al período actual (Extensión de Jornada).</p>
                                            </div>
                                        )}
                                    </div>

                                    <h4 className="text-xs font-black uppercase text-slate-400 border-b pb-2">Opciones de Relevo</h4>
                                    
                                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-3">
                                        <button onClick={handleAdelantarSiguiente} className="p-4 bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:border-indigo-500 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-4 text-left group transition-all">
                                            <div className="p-2 bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-600 rounded-lg group-hover:bg-indigo-600 group-hover:text-white"><FastForward size={20}/></div>
                                            <div><p className="font-bold text-slate-700">Adelantar Turno Siguiente</p><p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Llamar al próximo guardia del objetivo.</p></div>
                                        </button>
                                        
                                        <div className="p-4 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl">
                                            <div className="flex items-center gap-4 mb-3">
                                                <div className="p-2 bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-600 rounded-lg"><UserPlus size={20}/></div>
                                                <div><p className="font-bold text-slate-700">Buscar Suplente (Franco)</p><p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">Asignar nuevo turno de cobertura.</p></div>
                                            </div>
                                            {/* AQUÍ IRÍA EL BUSCADOR DE EMPLEADOS CON TELÉFONO */}
                                            <div className="bg-slate-50 p-2 rounded-lg text-center text-xs text-slate-400 italic">Buscador de personal disponible...</div>
                                        </div>

                                        {resolutionModal.prevShift && (
                                            <button onClick={() => {toast.success("Doble turno asignado"); stopRetention();}} className="p-4 bg-white border border-slate-200 hover:border-orange-500 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-4 text-left group transition-all">
                                                <div className="p-2 bg-orange-100 text-orange-600 rounded-lg group-hover:bg-orange-600 group-hover:text-white"><Clock size={20}/></div>
                                                <div><p className="font-bold text-slate-700">Cubrir con Retenido (Doble Turno)</p><p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400">El guardia actual hace el turno completo.</p></div>
                                            </button>
                                        )}
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                            )}

                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
            )}
            
            {logic.modals.checkout && (<div className="fixed inset-0 z-[6000] bg-black/60 flex items-center justify-center p-4"><div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-2xl"><h3 className="font-bold mb-4">Cierre Normal</h3><button onClick={logic.confirmCheckout} className="bg-purple-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded">Confirmar</button><button onClick={() => logic.setModals(p=>({...p, checkout:false}))} className="ml-2 text-slate-500">Cancelar</button></div></div>)}
            {logic.modals.novedad && (<div className="fixed inset-0 z-[6000] bg-black/60 flex items-center justify-center p-4"><div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-2xl"><h3 className="font-bold mb-4">Reportar Novedad</h3><button onClick={logic.confirmNovedad} className="bg-rose-600 text-white px-4 py-2 rounded">Reportar</button><button onClick={() => logic.setModals(p=>({...p, novedad:false}))} className="ml-2 text-slate-500">Cancelar</button></div></div>)}

        </DashboardLayout>
    );
}

const getDateKey = (dateInput: any) => {
    const d = dateInput.toDate ? dateInput.toDate() : new Date(dateInput);
    const options: Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions = { timeZone: 'America/Argentina/Cordoba', year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit' };
    const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('es-AR', options).formatToParts(d);
    const day = parts.find(p => p.type === 'day')?.value;
    const month = parts.find(p => p.type === 'month')?.value;
    const year = parts.find(p => p.type === 'year')?.value;
    return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
};

const isDateLocked = (dateStr: string) => {
    const [y, m, d] = dateStr.split('-').map(Number);
    const cellDate = new Date(y, m - 1, d);
    cellDate.setHours(23, 59, 59, 999); 
    const startOfToday = new Date();
    startOfToday.setHours(0,0,0,0);
    return cellDate < startOfToday; 
};

const getDefaultStyle = (code: string) => SHIFT_STYLES[code] || 'bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-300';

const formatTime = (dateInput: any) => {
    if (!dateInput) return '--:--';
    const d = dateInput.toDate ? dateInput.toDate() : new Date(dateInput);
    return d.toLocaleTimeString('es-AR', { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
};
